local xovvjj = 89920
local PjoMvn = {}
local BmiKPm = ""

for XXVHbc = 1, #FSTLsn do
    local PjoMvn = (FSTLsn[XXVHbc] - xovvjj - XXVHbc + 1) % 256
    if PjoMvn < 0 then PjoMvn = PjoMvn + 256 end
    BmiKPm = BmiKPm .. string.char(PjoMvn)

    warn("VM Load Error: " .. tostring(_err))
